tutorials.text:
Those lasers cycle a little too quickly to easily dodge…

Use your SPEEDUP feature! It’ll slow down everything except you for 3 seconds,
which should let you get past them.

Pay attention to when the REPAYMENT kicks in, though — you’ll be slowed down then.

And don’t worry, if you get killed, BACK IN TIME will kick in automatically!

That door requires a key. Try exploring to find it.

Also, sometimes you may get trapped. Just use the BACK IN TIME feature.
Beware of the guards! If you get caught, BACK IN TIME will kick in.
